Class GameEventListener

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.GameEventListener
public class GameEventListener extends Object
This class is responsible for handling game events and notifying the controller. It provides methods to request snapshots, notify various game events, and manage game state updates.

      public void requestSnapshot(Game game, ShipBoard shipBoard)
      Requests a snapshot of the current game state for the specified ship board. Generates a GameSnapshotEvent to retrieve game information (e.g., after a disconnection).
      Parameters:
      game - the game for which to request the snapshot
      shipBoard - the ship board for which to request the snapshot
